repairs.description: Crossan argues that Christian titles for Jesus repurposed imperial honors already applied to Augustus, framing Jesus as Caesar’s political and religious rival rather than inventing new vocabulary.
repairs.rationale: Recasts the proposition and its contextual inference as one complete sentence without adding evidence.

repairs.description: White argues that close comparison can reconcile Synoptic variations: Matthew’s verb meaning “acquire” resolves the staff-instruction discrepancy and shows how multiple accounts can enrich one another.
repairs.rationale: Combines the harmonization claim and its linguistic example in one complete, faithful sentence.
